data.heading: Agile POD-Based Delivery Model
data.subheading: Structuring Teams for High-Performance AI Acceleration
data.description: Agivant organizes work into scalable, skill-combination PODs—small, cross-functional autonomous teams (6–12 people) operating on Agile principles. This model enables fast iteration, rapid prototyping in the HRP Lab, and reliable production delivery for enterprise AI systems.
data.closingStatement: Horizontal DevOps, MLOps, and Platform Engineering teams manage NVIDIA-powered environments to ensure enterprise-wide scalability and operational consistency.

blocks.title: Accelerated LLM Training & Fine-Tuning
blocks.body: Enterprises can no longer rely solely on generic models. We build and fine-tune domain-specific LLMs that understand your business context.
items: CUDA Optimization: PyTorch/TensorFlow optimized for A100/H100 GPUs, slashing training time from weeks to hours.
Rapid Iteration: Validated in our Hyperintelligent Rapid Prototype Lab (HRP Lab).

blocks.title: High-Performance Inference for Agentic AI
blocks.body: Agivant builds Agentic AI systems that demand ultra-low latency to feel “human” and responsive.
items: Production Latency: Using TensorRT and Triton Inference Server for multi-step agents.
Scalable: Optimized for Salesforce Agentforce integrations and omnichannel bots.

blocks.title: GPU-Accelerated Data Processing
blocks.body: Breaking the bottlenecks of CPU-based processing for modern enterprise data velocity.
items: RAPIDS Advantage: Leveraging cuDF to accelerate ETL pipelines and feature engineering.
Industry Impact: Processing terabytes of data in near real time for BFSI and eCommerce.

blocks.eyebrow: BEYOND TEXT: PROCESSING THE WORLD VISUALLY
blocks.title: Computer Vision & Multimodal AI
blocks.body: Extending enterprise intelligence beyond text into visual and multimodal understanding.
items: Visual Workloads: High-speed OCR, visual search, and video analysis using cuDNN.
Multimodal GenAI: Seamlessly combining text, image, and audio workflows.

blocks.title: Infrastructure Optimization
blocks.body: Ensuring optimal performance and cost efficiency across GPU-powered cloud environments.
items: Cloud Agnostic: Optimizing workloads on Azure AI and AWS SageMaker GPU instances.
MLOps: Dynamic scaling to prevent waste while guaranteeing CUDA performance.

blocks.title: Advanced Model Distillation & Efficiency
blocks.body: Creating compact, high-performance models optimized for enterprise-scale deployment.
items: NVIDIA NeMo & Aligner: Enables Knowledge Distillation (KD) via TensorRT ModelOpt and supports KD during Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT).
TAO & Minitron: Pruning and distilling larger models (e.g., Llama-3.1 8B → 4B) using Logits-Distillation (KL-Divergence).
